content:
We are currently keeping a close eye on a range of iPhone 18 Pro accessories and planning to place our orders before the Friday cutoff, since we will be using them ourselves this year. If we had to pick, Apple's AirTag 2 and the all-new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are undoubtedly the best accessories to pair with the iPhone 18 Pro—not to mention the world's finest Polishing Cloth, which is equally worth buying. But this time we want to go deeper—we'll cover chargers, MagSafe car mounts, cases, wallets, and everything in between. Below, we'll go through them one by one.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance—Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben—Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael—Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin—Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan—MagSafe Car Mount (for iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando—Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Magnetic Power Bank
  • Simon—Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Charger
  • Justin—Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette—Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Other Genuinely Recommended Accessories

If you want to charge your newly purchased iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as quickly as possible, you'll need a compatible charging adapter. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply—and Apple's own offering is the best choice on the market. It's small enough and folds up neatly, getting your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case comes in a range of deep, rich colour options. It looks great and offers an excellent grippy feel, the anodised aluminium buttons have a solid tactile response, and the entire case is made from 100% recycled polyester yarn—good for the environment.

This compact 3-in-1 wireless charger from Anker can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone pad supporting Qi2 wireless charging and MagSafe compatibility. When folded, it's small enough to slip easily into a travel bag—which means you'll never have to lug a tangle of cables and adapters to your hotel again—or you can place it on your nightstand or desk to neatly organise your entire Apple ecosystem. It's currently running at nearly 35% off on Amazon, an all-time low price.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe has always been a must-have accessory for Apple fans who prefer a minimalist style. It can comfortably hold 3 to 4 cards—whether it's an ID card, a few credit cards, or hotel key cards—perfect for anyone who doesn't want to carry a bulky wallet around.

Every time I drive, I want to find a stable and secure spot to place my phone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can securely magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, and it clips directly onto the air vent for added convenience. This MagSafe car mount not only protects your iPhone well but also keeps the screen clearly visible, and charging while driving works perfectly with no issues at all.

I've always believed that a truly practical MagSafe magnetic power bank that you can carry with your iPhone every day has to be slim enough. Baseus has just released a magnetic power bank that I consider almost perfect. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It packs a built-in 5,000mAh battery and supports 7.5W wireless charging as well as 22.5W wired input. The best part is that it comes in a new burgundy colour that pairs beautifully with the new iPhone—this is what an ultra-slim magnetic power bank should look like.

If you travel frequently, you'll understand that keeping your tech bag neatly organised is already half the battle won. That's why I always keep an eye out for versatile charging solutions. Baseus's travel charger fits the bill perfectly—it supports plugs for over 200 countries and is designed to charge six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while also reliably powering your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Earlier, Michael picked what I consider the best foldable MagSafe charger for travel, but this time I want to focus on my two favourite desktop 3-in-1 models: the Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, which is absolutely stunning and minimalist in a beautiful space grey black; and the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also love—but the Satechi is simply too elegant and refined to compare.

After spending a fortune on the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually opt for more affordable accessories and don't splurge further on the most expensive items. Spigen has plenty of budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My personal top pick is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit case, priced significantly lower than other brands—and there are also opaque multi-colour options, all of which support MagSafe fast wireless charging. These cases feature DuraClear blue resin infused into the TPU frame to prevent yellowing, along with shock-absorbing design; it's worth noting that the Camera Control button surface is also wrapped in a thin layer of TPU.

  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • All-New Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fiber iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracker Card
